title: AuditLogEntry
description: Core six-field record for a single LLM API call attestation. Model-agnostic, jurisdiction-agnostic. v0.1-DRAFT.

entry_id.description: UUID v4. Client-generated. Server rejects duplicates with HTTP 409.

timestamp_utc.description: Server ingest clock, millisecond precision, RFC 3339. Authoritative timestamp. Client-submitted value stored separately as client_timestamp_utc.

client_timestamp_utc.description: Client-provided timestamp at call time, RFC 3339. Stored as-submitted. Server clock wins for ordering.

model_id.description: Free-form model identifier as returned by the LLM provider. Examples: claude-sonnet-4-6, gpt-4o, gemini-1.5-pro. Not an enum; provider strings evolve faster than schema versions.

caller_identity.description: Opaque customer-side identifier for the calling system or user. This service does not resolve or verify this value. Correctness is the submitting party's responsibility.

policy_version_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the customer's active AI usage policy document at call time. 64 lowercase hex characters. This service stores the hash as-submitted and does not retrieve or validate the referenced document.

human_review_flag.description: Three-state enum indicating human review status. Co-field requirements enforced by the referenced sub-schema.

signing_key_version.description: AWS KMS key version ID used to sign this entry at ingest. Enables audit verifiers to walk the key-transition chain.
